english.title: Cab driver start taximeter before hire period or stop beyond end of hire period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor cab, namely **(..SPECIFY CAB..),

(A)_[started the taximeter sooner than when the cab was hired]_
(B)_[stopped the taximeter later than when the hiring was terminated]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 39 and 53 of the London Cab Order 1934.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
driver of a motor cab shall start the taximeter no sooner than when the cab is hired or at such later time as the driver thinks fit
OR shall stop the taximeter no later than when the hiring is terminated or at such earlier time as the driver thinks fit
